VAN WINKLE

# PAPPY VAN WINKLE 15 YEAR

Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey

Expressly crafted from the exclusive Van Winkle family wheated recipe and carefully chosen from barrels in the heart of the aging warehouses, this bourbon matured undisturbed for 15 years in deep-charred heavy oak, untouched by human hands, guided only by time.

## TASTING NOTES

An elegant and sweet aroma with caramel corn and vanilla.

Features big flavor of leather, oak and complex fruitiness.

Finishes smooth with notes of spice and oak tannins.

## Reviews

### Professional

Rating: 98

## UNIQUE FACTS

The Van Winkle family has been producing bourbon for over a century, with each generation contributing to the brand's esteemed reputation.

Expressions like the Pappy Van Winkle 23 Year are aged for over two decades, offering a depth of flavor that is rare in the industry.

The Van Winkle Collection includes highly sought-after releases, such as the Old Rip Van Winkle 25 Year Old Bourbon, which is packaged in a handmade wooden box and comes with a certificate of authenticity signed by Julian Van Winkle.
